# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 753 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://agentscouthq.com/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: support@agentscouthq.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://agentscouthq.com/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://agentscouthq.com/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added
- [All new tools, last 30 days](https://agentscouthq.com/new.html)

- [Sidekick](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/sidekick.html) (added 2026-10-18): Native macOS app for chatting offline with a local LLM that can draw on your files, folders and websites.
- [OpenOutreach](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/openoutreach.html) (added 2026-10-18): Self-hosted AI agent for B2B lead generation that finds people matching your market, explains the fit and emails them from your mailbox.
- [SocratiCode](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/socraticode.html) (added 2026-10-18): Codebase context engine for AI agents with hybrid semantic search, dependency graphs and impact analysis, available as MCP, plugin or skill.
- [Google Workspace MCP](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/google-workspace-mcp.html) (added 2026-10-18): MCP server and CLI that gives AI assistants natural-language control of Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms, Tasks and Chat.
- [Metorial](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/metorial.html) (added 2026-10-18): Open-source identity and access layer that connects AI agents to 1,200+ integrations via MCP, CLI or API with auth, permissions and observability.
- [Open Terminal](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/open-terminal.html) (added 2026-10-18): Self-hosted terminal service from the Open WebUI team that gives AI agents an API to run commands, manage files and execute code.
- [EvoAgentX](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/evoagentx.html) (added 2026-10-18): Framework for building, evaluating and automatically evolving LLM agents and agentic workflows.
- [Atomic Agent](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/atomic-agent.html) (added 2026-10-18): Local-first AI agent that drives your browser, edits files and runs approved commands using local open-weight or cloud models.
- [II-Agent](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/ii-agent.html) (added 2026-10-18): Open-source AI agent for real work from Intelligent Internet that you can run, fork and extend with your own API keys.
- [Laminar](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/laminar.html) (added 2026-10-18): Open-source observability platform for AI agents with OpenTelemetry tracing, plain-English behavior tracking and alerts.
- [Mercury Agent](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/mercury-agent.html) (added 2026-10-18): Self-hosted personal AI agent with a written personality, local memory, permission-gated tools and token budgets, reachable via CLI or Telegram.
- [BeeAI Framework](https://agentscouthq.com/tools/beeai-framework.html) (added 2026-10-18): Framework for building production-ready agents and multi-agent systems in Python or TypeScript.
